selection_rule: Six DPRM-only wins selected after the paired aggregate audit to cover distinct arithmetic failure modes. Cases 159 and 284 are the original paper examples; cases 1209, 246, 908, and 50 extend the project-page gallery.
metric_use: The gallery is qualitative pipeline-level interpretation. Aggregate claims use all 1319 paired examples, and the same-checkpoint decoder probe is reported separately.
